basic_details.job_title: DLSA Chandrapur Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: District Legal Services Authority, Chandrapur (DLSA Chandrapur) has notified vacancies for the Para Legal Volunteer post on a contract basis under its 2026 recruitment, with the last date to submit applications by post or in person set for 31 October 2026. Eligible candidates can apply through the prescribed offline process by submitting their completed applications to the District Legal Services Authority, District Court, Chandrapur. Applicants must hold a minimum 10th pass qualification. This voluntary position carries no salary, providing only an honorarium as decided by District Legal Serv

qualification.details: Applicants must have passed at least the 10th standard. Preference in selection is given to candidates falling under the following categories: retired teachers, former panchayat members, retired government employees, social workers, women, transgenders, tribal communities, marginalized sections of society, and other eminent persons.

selection_process: The selection is made by the District Legal Services Authority
Chandrapur based on scrutiny of received applications and preference given to eligible category persons. Selected legal volunteers receive no regular salary or allowances
only an honorarium determined by the authority.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible and interested candidates must submit their applications in the prescribed format along with necessary enclosures to the District Legal Services Authority, District Court, Chandrapur by 31 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM. Applications received after the stipulated date and time will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for DLSA Chandrapur Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 31 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Legal Volunteer post?
faq.answer: Applicants must have passed at least the 10th standard.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any salary or monthly pay for this position?
faq.answer: No salary, wages, or allowances are paid; volunteers receive only an honorarium as determined by DLSA Chandrapur.

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to get preference in the selection process?
faq.answer: Preference is given to retired teachers, former panchayat members, retired government employees, social workers, women, transgenders, tribal communities, marginalized sections of society, and other eminent persons.

faq.question: Q5. How should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in the prescribed format along with required documents to the District Legal Services Authority, District Court, Chandrapur by post or in person.
